title: Record positive SRD audit assurances as freeze evidence
description:
Purpose:
- Preserve the high-value positive results from Fable/Codex so future agents do not re-litigate already verified clean areas while fixing findings.

Evidence to record:
- Every spell: name, level/school line, ritual tag, casting time, range, components/material text, duration, higher-levels text, description, damage dice/save abilities/attack flags verified; concentration flags correct except Protection from Evil and Good.
- Class spell lists: exact parity both directions for pages 105-113, 70 groups, 778 memberships.
- Every creature: all ability scores, speeds, saves, skills, senses, languages, immunities/resistances, CR, traits/actions/reactions/legendary action text verified; attack average/dice/DC consistency clean.
- Every equipment row, magic item type/rarity/attunement/description, table record, condition/rule/feature/hazard/background/ancestry reviewed; Fable reported numeric fidelity essentially perfect.
- Modeling strengths: typed per-level advancement, structured starting-equipment refs/filter catalogs, 22 typed table projections, structured ancestry ASI/languages, exhaustion levels, deck/flask/apparatus tables complete.
- Audit artifacts: durable harness + reports at ~/src/dnd5e-srd-audit-harness-070126/, bundle dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle-070126.zip at commit beb9a21.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a durable audit note/evidence doc summarizing positive assurances and the exact bundle/commit reviewed.
- Cross-link this audit epic and child findings.
- Make clear that positive assurance does not close the outstanding finding beads.
